subject: Re: POC trial planning & workload intake \u0014 AcmeHealth
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmehealth.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC trial planning & workload intake  AcmeHealth

Hi Jane / Alex -

Great to meet you on the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can kick off the POC smoothly:

Summary of intent
- Goal: validate Redwood Inference for Acme Health chat & triage workflows (live user traffic + nightly batch scoring)
- Success criteria (preliminary):
   Latency: p95 end-to-end inference < 250 ms for interactive flows
   Quality: intent classification F1 >= 0.92 on your eval set or no regressions vs current baseline
   Cost: unit inference cost target to be reviewed (benchmark during trial)
   Reliability: survive bursts without >1% error rate

Proposed evaluation plan
- 2-week trial (suggested start date: 2027-08-09)
- Redwood will provision a dedicated staging instance; we'll run scripted load tests plus a small percentage (~5%) of real traffic if you want
- Acceptance: you sign off when quality metrics + latency/cost targets met on test suite

What we need from you (workload intake) - please fill the attached poc_workload_intake_sheet.xlsx or provide the values below:
- Steady-state RPS (requests/sec)
- Peak/burst RPS and typical burst duration
- Concurrency targets (max concurrent requests)
- Typical prompt token length (avg / 95th) and completion token length (avg / 95th)
- Monthly request and token estimates
- Any heavy batch jobs (size, schedule)
- Sample payloads (please attach) and auth method
- Any regulatory/data residency constraints

Owners & next steps
- I'll coordinate the kickoff and be primary point of contact for procurement questions
- CC'd: Marissa Cole (POC PM) and Dylan Brooks (infra lead) who will own provisioning and metrics

Attachments: poc_workload_intake_sheet.xlsx

Proposed follow-ups
- Fill the intake sheet by EOD Tue 2027-08-03 if possible
- Quick kickoff call the week of 2027-08-04 to align the test plan

Thanks - looking forward to getting this running.

Best,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-08-02T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC trial planning & workload intake  AcmeHealth

Hi Ben -

Thanks for the recap - the plan looks good and Aug 9 works for a start. I filled the intake sheet and pasted the high-level numbers below so you can size the trial:

Workload overview (high-level)
- Steady-state RPS: ~6-8 RPS during business hours
- Peak bursts: up to ~60 RPS for short bursts (~10-15 minutes); these typically happen 1-2x/day around 10-11am PST
- Concurrency: we see up to 12 concurrent interactive requests; additionally we run nightly batch scoring jobs that can temporarily add 150-200 concurrent requests for ~20-40 minutes (once per night)
- Token lengths:
   Prompt avg: 35 tokens, 95th: ~90
   Completion avg: 140 tokens, 95th: ~300
- Monthly: ~90k requests/mo, ~12M tokens/mo (estimated)
- Sample payloads: attached sample_payloads.json (contains anonymized examples)
- Security: we'd like to review SOC2 summary and confirm US-only data residency for the trial

Notes: our priority is maintaining sub-300ms p95 for interactive flows and stable behavior during nightly batch windows. We'll start with a small % of live traffic if Redwood is comfortable with our monitoring hooks.

Attachments: sample_payloads.json

Best,
Jane Doe
Head of ML Ops, Acme Health
jane.doe@acmehealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-08-02T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC trial planning & workload intake  AcmeHealth

Jane - thanks for the fast turnaround and the numbers, very helpful.

High-level Redwood plan based on your profile:
- Provision a dedicated staging cluster sized for: sustained 10 RPS, short bursts to 80 RPS, and handling nightly batch windows (we'll provision headroom for 250 concurrent during batch windows)
- Configuration: adaptive batching + KV prefix caching to optimize cost while preserving latency; we'll tune quantization and kernel paths for your model during onboarding
- Monitoring: p95/p99 latency, error rates, token usage dashboards, and per-route cost estimates (we'll share access before you route any live traffic)

Acceptance criteria (to be finalized during kickoff) - proposal:
- p95 latency < 250-300 ms for interactive flows under normal traffic
- Error rate < 1% during bursts and batch windows (measured by 5 minute buckets)
- Quality: no regression on your eval set (we'll run the test harness you provide)

Owners / immediate next steps
- Marissa Cole (CC) will run the POC as PM and schedule the kickoff call (action: Marissa to propose times)
- Dylan Brooks (CC) will provision the cluster and set up the test harness & perf scripts (action: Dylan to confirm cluster size by 2027-08-04)
- Ben (me) will provide a set of sample prompts + a short k6/Torch load test to simulate both interactive and batch patterns

Security / compliance
- Attaching SOC2 summary (soc2_summary.pdf) and link to our compliance page. We'll confirm data residency controls during kickoff.

Links: Mutual Action Plan: https://drive.redwood.com/AcmeHealth/MutualActionPlan
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/ACME-POC-2027-07

Proposed kickoff: Aug 4 or Aug 5 (30-45m) - Marissa, can you propose 2 slots?

Thanks - we'll prepare a test harness and a small initial traffic ramp plan.

Best,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-03T10:32:00-07:00
Subject: AcmeHealth POC - internal next steps

Marissa / Dylan - forwarding Jane's intake and my reply. Key internal actions and owners below:

1) Marissa (POC PM) - schedule kickoff with Acme (propose Aug 4 and Aug 5 slots), own the mutual action plan and scorecard. Deliverable: finalized MAP + test acceptance criteria by EOD 2027-08-05.

2) Dylan (Infra) - provision dedicated staging cluster sized for: sustained 10 RPS, headroom to 80 RPS for short bursts, and capacity for nightly batch windows (support up to 250 concurrent during batch). Set up dashboards: p95/p99 latency, error rate, tokens/min, cost per route. Deliverable: cluster up & perf harness deployed by 2027-08-04.

3) Ben (me) - provide sample prompts, k6 load tests (interactive + batch patterns), coordinate SOC2 and drive link sharing. Deliverable: test artifacts uploaded to drive by 2027-08-03 EOD.

Reference from Acme (excerpt):
"Steady-state RPS: ~6-8 RPS; Peak bursts up to ~60 RPS for 10-15 minutes; nightly batch adds 150-200 concurrent for ~20-40 minutes; prompt avg 35 tokens, completion avg 140 tokens; monthly ~90k requests / ~12M tokens."

I'll follow up after kickoff to refine acceptance criteria and run a dry-run load test.

Thanks,
Ben
